mapper.select: SELECT id,nickname,avatar_url,city,user_role,buyer_verify_status,carrier_verify_status, enterprise_verify_status,performance_score,star_avg,deal_count,created_at FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{user} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE t_profiles SET nickname=COALESCE(#{nickname},nickname),city=COALESCE(#{city},city) WHERE id=#{user} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.sql: id,order_no,item_name,item_spec,quantity,unit,goods_amount,service_fee,shipping_fee,status, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agreed_json,'$.insurance_quote_id')) AS insurance_quote_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agreed_json,'$.insurance_choice')) AS insurance_choice, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(agreed_json,'$.pricing_version')) AS pricing_version, shipping_fee_status,tracking_no,insured,insurance_premium,buyer_deposit,vendor_deposit, buyer_deposit_status,vendor_deposit_status,expect_arrive_date,promised_arrive_date, created_at,updated_at,CASE WHEN buyer_id=#{user} THEN 'buyer' ELSE 'carrier' END AS my_role
mapper.select: SELECT ,ref_image_urls FROM t_orders WHERE id=#{id} AND (buyer_id=#{user} OR vendor_id=#{user})
SELECT balance AS balance_amount,'CNY' AS currency,points FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{user} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id,kind,amount,balance_after,order_id,note,created_at FROM t_balance_ledger WHERE user_id=#{user} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id,kind,title,body,order_id,read_flag,created_at FROM t_notifications WHERE user_id=#{user} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notifications SET read_flag=1 WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{user}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_notifications WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{user}
